name: app.qrcodecreator/qr-codes
title: QR Code Creator
description: Free QR codes for any URL with no signup or API key, plus scan analytics. Pro makes links editable.

tools.name: create_qr_code
tools.description: Free. Creates a scannable QR code from a website URL, such as a restaurant menu, event page, business website or product link, with no account or API key required. Returns the PNG image, download links on QRCodeCreator.app for the PNG (imageUrl) and SVG (svgUrl), and the SVG markup when format is "svg". Owners can create a shareable page from their portfolio. Requires a destination URL; supports public HTTP/HTTPS links, not Wi-Fi credentials, contact cards, arbitrary text or decoding an existing QR image. Every code encodes a scan link (scanUrl) on QRCodeCreator.app that counts scans and forwards to the URL, so its destination can be changed later by an owner with Pro without reprinting. Signed in or with an API key, the code belongs to that account. Otherwise the result includes a claimUrl, valid for 30 days, that adds the code to the QR codes of whoever opens it on QRCodeCreator.app. Unsafe links and links to private or internal hosts are refused with an error that names the reason.

url.description: Destination website URL to encode, e.g. https://example.com/menu. Required; https:// is added if no scheme is given.

format.description: Hosted PNG and SVG links are always returned. "svg" also returns the SVG markup.

tools.name: get_scan_analytics
tools.description: Free. Returns how many times a QR code was scanned, in total and per UTC day. Needs no API key: the counts for a code can be read by anyone with its ID. If the code's owner does not have Pro ($9/month), only the last 7 days are included (historyDays in the result); with Pro, the full history is.

id.description: QR code ID from create_qr_code or list_qr_codes, e.g. "QR-ABCD1234EF".

tools.name: list_qr_codes
tools.description: Free. Lists the QR codes in the signed-in account (or the API key owner's), newest first, optionally only those whose name or destination URL contains a search term, such as "lunch menu" or "example.com/events". Returns each code's id, name (set with rename_qr_code or on QRCodeCreator.app; null if unnamed), current destination url, createdAt, scanUrl and manageUrl, plus total and truncated. The id works with get_scan_analytics, rename_qr_code and update_destination. Needs sign-in (OAuth) or an API key, and lists only that account's codes. At most 50 codes per call.

query.description: Text to look for in the code's name or destination URL, case-insensitive. Omit to list every code.

tools.name: rename_qr_code
tools.description: Free. Sets the name of a QR code in the signed-in account, the label shown in My QR Codes on QRCodeCreator.app and matched by list_qr_codes searches. Replaces any existing name; an empty name removes it. The name is only a label: it does not change the image, the scan link or where the code points. Needs the code's owner: signed in (OAuth) or an API key (Authorization: Bearer qrcd_...) whose owner owns the code. If the code belongs to someone else, it returns not_owner. Returns the code's id and its new name (null if removed).

id.description: QR code ID from list_qr_codes or create_qr_code, e.g. "QR-ABCD1234EF".

name.description: The new name, up to 100 characters, e.g. "Black Friday flyer". An empty string removes the name.

tools.name: update_destination
tools.description: Changes the URL a "redirect" QR code sends people to, so a printed code can point somewhere new. Requires Pro ($9/month) and the code's owner: signed in (OAuth) or an API key (Authorization: Bearer qrcd_...) whose owner owns the code. If the owner doesn't have Pro, it returns pro_required; if the code belongs to someone else, not_owner. The new URL gets the same safety checks as create_qr_code.

id.description: QR code ID, e.g. "QR-ABCD1234EF". Must be a "redirect" code to have any effect on scans.

url.description: The new destination, an http or https URL.

tools.name: get_plan_status
tools.description: Free. Signed in (OAuth) or with an API key, returns whether that account has Pro, the subscription status and when the current period ends. Otherwise, returns what the free and Pro plans include and the Pro price ($9/month).

tools.name: start_pro_subscription
tools.description: Pro costs $9/month. Returns a checkoutUrl for the Pro subscription, with the plan and its price. Getting the link is free: it charges nothing and changes no account; a subscription starts only if a person opens the link and completes Stripe checkout in their browser. Signed in or with an API key, Pro applies to that account; otherwise it applies to the browser that completes checkout, including codes added to it with a claimUrl. If that account already has Pro, returns alreadyPro: true and no link.

email.description: Email to fill in on the checkout page.
